# Tegegn Wukianos — Ethiopian Developer & Portfolio

> Tegegn Wukianos is an Ethiopian developer and IT student based in Wolaita Sodo, Ethiopia. He builds web applications, backend systems, and automation tools for local and global users, with experience in Python, JavaScript, C++, and modern web frameworks such as FastAPI, Django, Next.js, and React.

## About

Tegegn Wukianos is an Ethiopian developer and IT student at Wolaita Sodo University, based in Wolaita Sodo, Ethiopia. He focuses on building practical software: web applications, backend systems, automation scripts, and scraping tools, as well as student-focused products such as a dining app and a lost-and-found Telegram bot. His skill set spans Python, JavaScript, C++, Flutter, and frameworks including FastAPI, Django, Node.js, Express.js, and Next.js, with databases like PostgreSQL and Supabase. He holds certificates in Generative AI with AWS, AI Fundamentals from Udacity, web development from Muyalogy, and Local SEO from Skillshare. He has built projects including a voting management system in C++, a real-time Ethiopian forex currency monitor comparing bank rates, and Telegram bots for content downloading and campus lost-and-found. He works primarily in Amharic and English, reaching users across Ethiopia and beyond through open-source projects on GitHub.

## Projects & Case Studies

- [Tegegn Wukianos Portfolio](https://tegegn.com.et/): Personal portfolio and project showcase of Ethiopian developer Tegegn Wukianos.
- [taAI: Wolaytta AI & Multilingual Translator Case Study](https://tegegn.com.et/projects/taai/): Technical case study on building taAI: a generative AI assistant and bidirectional translation engine for the low-resource Wolaytta language using Google Gemini, Flask blueprints, and Supabase.
- [EMWA Donation & Payment Gateway Integration Case Study](https://tegegn.com.et/projects/emwa-payment/): Case study on integrating the Chapa payment gateway, TanStack Start server functions, and automated PDF receipt generation for the Ethiopian Media Women Association (EMWA) at https://ethmwa.org/ (Role: Payment Integration Engineer).
- [Visit Wolaita Tourism & AI Try-On Case Study](https://tegegn.com.et/projects/visit-wolaita/): Technical case study on building a cultural tourism portal featuring an AI Virtual Try-On API for traditional Ethiopian attire using Python and Flask.
- [Ethiopia Forex Monitor Case Study](https://tegegn.com.et/projects/forex-monitor/): In-depth case study on real-time Ethiopian commercial bank exchange rate scraping and normalized REST API architecture.
- [WSU Lost & Found Bot Case Study](https://tegegn.com.et/projects/wsu-lost-and-found/): Technical breakdown of a trilingual (English, Amharic, Afaan Oromoo) campus Telegram bot using Python and FSM state handling.
- [Sirba: Ad-Free Android Music Player Case Study](https://tegegn.com.et/projects/sirba/): Technical case study on building Sirba, an ad-free Android music player that lets users import Spotify and YouTube Music playlists and play them instantly with real-time synchronized lyrics and background playback (Built by Tegegn Dev).
- [WSU Dining App Case Study](https://tegegn.com.et/projects/wsu-dining-app/): Architecture deep dive into Flutter QR scanner optimization, Supabase RLS security, offline reconciliation, and Ethiopian calendar sync for campus meal digitalization.
- [Kokeba Social Audio App Case Study](https://tegegn.com.et/projects/kokeba/): Full-stack case study on React 19, Supabase, Wavesurfer.js audio visualization, and Google Gemini AI automated moderation for Ethiopian voice sharing.
- [GitHub Profile](https://github.com/tegegndev): Open-source repositories including a C++ voting management system, a forex currency monitor, a WSU dining app, and Telegram automation bots.
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/tegegn-wukianos-1a6469290): Professional profile with work history and certifications.
- [Curriculum Vitae](https://tegegn.com.et/assets/images/Tegegn_Wukainos_CV.pdf): Downloadable CV for Tegegn Wukianos.
